pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown, polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are mostly smooth with localized pixelation. Flank patches exhibit larger surface area relative to smaller, more fragmented patches on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forming a continuous tessellation. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial (Y-junctions). Path thickness is consistent across the mid-flank, with high continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The mane consists of short, dark follicles creating a jagged 1D profile against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, dark avian commensals (oxpeckers) clinging to the dorsal ridge near the base of the neck and shoulder.
